name: chatpane
description: An unofficial desktop app for Facebook Messenger, built with Tauri.

scripts.lint: biome check inject scripts/debug scripts/i18n scripts/site
scripts.format: biome check --write inject scripts/debug scripts/i18n scripts/site
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build:inject && bun run build:site
